description: This Java source file defines the ICalHandlerFactory class, which implements a WebDAV request handler factory for iCalendar. It maps HTTP methods to specific handler functions, primarily delegating to the ICalWorker class for GET, PUT, and PROPFIND requests, and handles other methods with default responses.

classes.name: ICalHandlerFactory
classes.description: A factory class implementing RequestHandlerFactory to handle WebDAV requests for iCalendar, mapping HTTP methods to specific handlers.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns the appropriate RequestHandler based on the HTTP method.

methods.name: handleInvalidMethod
methods.description: Handles unsupported HTTP methods by logging and sending a 405 error.

methods.name: doNothing
methods.description: Handles methods that require no action, simply logging and setting status to OK.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests by delegating to ICalWorker.handleGetRequest.

methods.name: doPut
methods.description: Handles PUT requests by delegating to ICalWorker.handlePutRequest.

methods.name: doPropFind
methods.description: Handles PROPFIND requests by delegating to ICalWorker.handlePropFindRequest.
